notes: Eclipse Loop 1.8.0 MIDI sync in both directions, plugin-only inserts, and a long audit that found several things quietly wrong for a long time. Fixed — the important ones - The export was a different mix. Bounce and stems read one set of faders while live arranger playback read another, and the mixer writes the arranger's set whenever FADERS is on ARRANGE — the mode you mix a song in. A song mixed that way exported at different levels, pans, mutes and solos than it played at. The session looked right; only the file was wrong. Export now reads the arranger's own mixer, and honours VCA groups. - The master chain had two owners — one stateful limiter or bus compressor was called twice per block with two unrelated streams, so it mis-responded to both. - Effects stayed stuck after Clear. Humanize / Half / Shuffle / Rev stayed armed with their buttons lit, and new material inherited them. - Arranger sends were dead, the FX rack and VCA groups were dead in the arranger, and the inspector's sends and I/O were painted but never wired. - Sends E–H and bus pan/solo never persisted. - Edits are audible mid-playback — the re-read was never wired.
